channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: hermes-tenuo (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: hermes-tenuo is a Tenuo plugin for Hermes Agent that uses signed, expiring warrants to limit tool calls and their arguments. Its Hands feature connects a remote Hermes chat to a chosen folder on a Mac or Linux laptop for terminal and file work, with an OS sandbox.

item.title: Open-Agent-API (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Open Agent API exposes agents through an API-compatible gateway: callers use an agent ID as the `model` value and can connect through OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini SDKs. The README describes publishing agents, issuing API keys, and handling approval pauses for sensitive actions; it also includes a local sample agent and a quickstart flow.

item.title: Wiro-Hermes (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Wiro-Hermes provides two plugins for Hermes Agent: `wiro-media` adds tools for image, video, speech, music, transcription, and 3D tasks, while `wiro` connects the Wiro AI LLM gateway as a model provider. Both use a Wiro AI API key; the provider offers GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, and Grok models through an OpenAI-compatible API.

item.title: youtube-transcript-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: youtube-transcript-skills is an Agent Skill that lets compatible AI agents use the getyoutubetranscript.com API to fetch YouTube transcripts and search videos or channels. It also supports channel and playlist browsing, searches within channels, and other video and channel information requests.

item.title: hermes-guests (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Guests is a plugin for sharing selected Hermes tools with guests through their own Telegram accounts. Owners review and approve each guest’s permissions, which are enforced by signed, expiring warrants; guests can request additional access, and owners can manage or end access from chat.

item.title: scavio-hermes-skill (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides a hosted MCP server for structured data from 31 platforms and an Extract endpoint for URLs. It includes five workflow skills for product research, competitor analysis, price comparison, Reddit sentiment, and YouTube research.

item.title: agent-browser-mcp (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Agent-browser-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that enables AI agents to interact directly with a user's active Chrome browser session rather than a sandboxed environment. It works through a local bridge and a Chrome extension to maintain existing login states, cookies, and open tabs while providing low-level control. item.title: ai-emotion-chip (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Emotion Chip is a Hermes Agent plugin that adds written delivery cues, such as whispers, sighs, and pauses, to speech generated with ElevenLabs v4 or Fish Audio. It provides commands to check settings and inspect how cues are rendered, and supports offline rendering without keys or network access.

item.title: hermes-cloud-file-manager (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Cloud File Manager lets you browse, search, upload, and download files and folders on the machine running a Hermes agent from Hermes Desktop. It can preview supported files, lets you review Markdown and text edits before saving, and can optionally browse and import files from Google Drive when the agent is signed in through its google-workspace skill.

item.title: heartbeat2 (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: HeartBeat 2.0 is a Hermes plugin that lets an agent work between messages through scheduled turns, standing roles, and watchers for files, processes, URLs, commands, or Hermes events. It checks wakes and watchers with plain code and starts a model turn only when work is due or a watcher condition is met; daily turn and message limits, quiet hours, and other settings govern its activity.

item.title: fish-audio-hermes (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Fish Audio for Hermes is a plugin that adds Fish Audio speech and transcription to Hermes CLI, supported messaging apps, and Desktop. It supports voice selection and design, voice cloning, speech-to-text, and commands for setup, previews, and account information.

item.title: hermes-personal-assistant (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Personal Assistant is a Hermes plugin that maintains context, action records, and workflow state across conversations. It can prepare tasks on real sites and present an approval packet before the final action; its documented workflows include calendar and meeting preparation, inbox follow-up, household administration, shopping, and travel.

item.title: caduceus (Domain Applications)
item.description: Caduceus is a Hermes plugin that imports DNA data, Apple Health exports, and health records into a SQLite vault on the user's machine. It provides cited health answers using those sources and published research, and can generate a health brief and watch for new research on the user's gene–drug pairs.

item.title: boardstate-hermes-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Boardstate is a Hermes plugin that lets an agent create and update a board of KPI cards, tables, charts, notes, and other widgets. The board is saved in the user’s Hermes home and can be viewed in the Hermes web dashboard or Hermes Desktop.

item.title: glasses-platform (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Glasses is a Hermes Agent gateway plugin that connects smart glasses and other devices to an agent through a companion app, WebSocket, or HTTP. It supports photo-based questions, voice interaction, reminders and approvals; the README says it is a preview and has not been tested on real devices.

item.title: hermes-teammates (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: Hermes Teammates adds a configurable roster of named subagents, each with its own instructions, tools, and optional model. It supports background runs, follow-ups that include earlier results, and a Kanban lane where completed cards wait for approval before dependent cards proceed.

item.title: hermes-plan-mode (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Plan Mode is a plugin that lets Hermes explore a task with read-only tools, write a plan, and require approval before implementation. After approval, it can implement the plan in the same turn and track progress in a todo list.

item.title: dosbox-mcp (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: dosbox-mcp is an MCP server that connects an MCP-capable agent to a running dosbox-automation emulator. Its tools support session control, screen text and captures, video recording, Lua scripting, keyboard and mouse input, and memory access.

item.title: sugar (Memory & Context)
item.description: Sugar is local-first infrastructure for coordinating coding agents through a durable SQLite task queue, with atomic claims, leases, and a shared activity history. It also provides project and global memory stores, searchable through local embeddings or FTS5 keyword search, and exposes tasks and memory through MCP, a CLI, REST, and a dashboard.

item.title: membase (Memory & Context)
item.description: Membase provides Python and TypeScript clients, a command-line tool, and an MCP server for adding, searching, and managing memories. It supports hosted storage in a Membase account and a local mode, and documents integrations with several AI clients and agent frameworks.

item.title: memoria (Memory & Context)
item.description: Memoria is a persistent memory layer for AI agents that tracks memory changes and supports snapshots, branches, merges, and rollback. It offers semantic search and can be used through Memoria Cloud or a self-hosted setup; the README also documents a Hermes plugin with optional automatic capture.

item.title: monitor (Memory & Context)
item.description: BetterDB Monitor is a monitoring tool for Valkey and Redis that stores slowlogs, command patterns, and client activity for historical review. It includes MONITOR capture sessions, cluster visibility, client analytics, and capacity forecasting; Key Analytics and anomaly detection are Pro features, free in early access.

item.title: hermes-dreaming (Memory & Context)
item.description: hermes-dreaming runs nightly, deterministic memory consolidation for Hermes Agent. A Python script checks conversations and stored memory, then presents proposals for the agent to apply through its regular memory tool; it does not call an LLM or write memory itself. It also records candidate provenance and can report task outcomes when enabled.

item.title: lcm-x (Memory & Context)
item.description: LCM-X is a context engine for Hermes Agent that stores messages in a local SQLite database and compacts older context into hierarchical summaries. It keeps the active prompt bounded and provides tools to search and recover details from stored messages and summaries.

item.title: optmem-hermes-plugin (Memory & Context)
item.description: Local append-only Hermes memory provider with decay compression, BM25 retrieval and reversible native-memory migration.

item.title: hermes-gbrain (Memory & Context)
item.description: Community Hermes plugin connecting GBrain memory over MCP, with profile setup and maintenance helpers.

item.title: hermes-official-plugins (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Official Plugins is Nous Research’s repository of first-party plugins for Hermes Agent. The README describes it as a collection of integrations and extensions, with each official plugin in its own directory and installable through the Hermes plugin catalog.

item.title: hwiki (Memory & Context)
item.description: Markdown wiki memory provider for Hermes with local SQLite FTS5 recall and append-only memory notes.

item.title: HyAtlas-Memory (Memory & Context)
item.description: HyAtlas is a Go memory server with an eight-layer memory model, local BGE-small embeddings, and an embedded vector store. It can extract and organize facts, intentions, summaries, and entity pages through configurable OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoints, then search those memories; retired memories can be restored.

item.title: ReMe (Memory & Context)
item.description: ReMe is a local-first knowledge base for AI agents that turns conversations and resources into readable, editable, searchable Markdown memory. It retrieves relevant passages using BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and supports shared workspaces through integrations, a CLI, HTTP, MCP, and Python APIs.
